release.name: spatial-morpheus-v0.1 (same frozen morpheus_factorized representation configuration as renal_spatial_v02/v03, full width, no variance/covariance penalty)
release.evidence_note: the sealed evidence above is a ccRCC development result on one slide (INT1) with shared spots between proposal and replication splits; it fixes the representation configuration only, was never breast-specific, and is not cited as independent replication for this campaign

discovery.candidate_budget_meaning: frozen candidates entering the ledger at stage 'proposed' after the fold sweep; raw per-target proposals are internal search and are never ledger entries
discovery.outer_split: five grouped patient folds over the 31 HEST breast-IDC patients on-store (1 sample = 1 patient for fold-grouping; a few patients contribute multiple sections, all sections of a patient stay in the same fold), deterministic shuffle with fold_seed; each fold in turn is D_R, the other four are D_P; HVG selection, z-score statistics, PCA of image embeddings and program ranking are fit on D_P only

targets.definition_rule: every response is response-free defined, within-patient centred, and never derived from a gene set under test

morphology.morph_pc1: H-optimus per-spot embedding PC 1, PCA fit on D_P, patient-residualised
morphology.cv_count: CellViT nuclei assigned to the spot (nearest-spot assignment, radius = spot_diameter_fullres / 2, per-sample spot_diameter from HEST_v1_3_0.csv so it generalises across the legacy ST and Visium/Visium HD platforms mixed in this cohort), log1p
morphology.cv_area: mean nuclear polygon area of the spot's nuclei
morphology.cv_frac_Neoplastic: fraction of the spot's nuclei in CellViT class Neoplastic

spatial_organisation.nbr_mp1..nbr_mp8: neighbour-mean (k=6, within sample) of the 8 Gavish malignant metaprogram scores with the highest within-patient Moran's I on D_P; program identities recorded per fold in the receipt

discovery.candidate_variables: the D_P-selected 300 highest-variance genes (log-CPM, patient fixed effect removed, z-scored with D_P statistics) and, for the morpheus_factorized arm, its representation coordinates mapped back to genes by response-free observed-coordinate links
excluded_from_candidates: st_technology platform indicator (legacy 'Spatial Transcriptomics' vs Visium vs Visium HD)

always: the 41 Gavish program scores of the spot
st_technology platform indicator (one-hot: legacy ST / Visium / Visium HD)
when_order_ge_3: all pairwise products of the candidate's variables
competitor_set.rule: the simpler model is fit on D_P and frozen; gain = R2(simpler + candidate feature, D_R) - R2(simpler, D_R)
competitor_set.exclusion_clause: the simpler model never contains the response or a deterministic function of it: for cv_frac_<class> targets all CellViT class fractions are excluded from the baseline (they sum to one); for nbr_mp<k> targets the target program's own neighbour mean is excluded (the other 40 neighbour-mean programs and the spot's own 41 program scores remain); receipts record the baseline column names. This clause is carried in from renal_spatial_v03 (registered after v02's baseline leaked the response for these same target families) and is adopted here from the start rather than re-discovered.

null_suite.spatial_block: within-patient 2D block swap (6x6 grid) of the response on D_R (destroys spatial organisation, keeps marginals)
null_suite.within_patient_perm: permutation of the response within patient on D_R
null_suite.interaction_break: for |S| >= 2, within-patient block swap of one constituent variable on D_R (breaks joint structure, keeps marginals)

advance_rule.proposed: top 30 (source) + top 20 (morpheus_factorized) candidates by mean replication gain over folds in which they recur; recorded with fold_gains, null p per kind, baseline_width, arm, proposal mechanism, budget
advance_rule.internal: recurrence in >= 3 of 5 folds with replication gain >= 0.02 in each, all three nulls p <= 0.05 in the recurring folds, BH q <= 0.10 over the 50 frozen candidates
advance_rule.external: CPTAC BRCA (121 RNA patients, 125 protein patients) bulk-RNA transfer of the frozen feature vs slide-level H&E descriptors (H-optimus slide mean/std PCs, CellViT slide summaries, once acquired): scale extension, same sign, p <= 0.05
advance_rule.orthogonal: CPTAC BRCA proteomics transfer of the frozen feature, same sign, p <= 0.05
advance_rule.actionable: predeclared prognosis (CPTAC BRCA clinical/followup; a second public breast-cancer survival cohort such as TCGA-BRCA via cBioPortal, same acquisition method as tcga_kirc_20260925, not yet on-store) after state lock and an EIG-ranked discriminating experiment; treatment claims remain blocked pending raw patient-level randomized trial data

stop_rules: no candidate reaches 'internal' at budget 50: every candidate logged with stop_reason; report 'no discovery at budget 50 under hest-breast-idc-v01'; a v0.2 for this campaign may change the target class, never this advance rule
all survivors labelled 'known' by the novelty tool: report as independent replication of known biology (levels 1-3), no novelty claim
sign reversal on any external transfer: candidate stops at 'internal'; hash stays locked
